text: ZPR is a business in the tertiary sector. It has 1 restaurant which has 20 employees. The Human
Resources Manager is preparing a job description as ZPR needs 2 new chefs. He said: ‘I need to
advertise the job vacancies externally. ZPR will use a range of financial rewards as it can be difficult
to recruit employees.’ The manager knows there are many factors for a business to consider when
deciding who to recruit.
